title: Global SaaS Platform Networking
scenario: A SaaS company serves customers in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. They need a global networking architecture that minimizes latency for all users, supports multi-tenant isolation, and complies with data residency requirements (EU data must stay in EU). Design the networking layer for this global platform.
requirements: VPCs in three Regions (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1)
Global Accelerator or CloudFront for global traffic optimization
Transit Gateway inter-Region peering for backend communication
Tenant isolation using security groups and subnet segmentation
VPC endpoints for AWS service access in each Region
